hook.text: Cheetahs are so genetically alike that skin grafts between unrelated cheetahs aren't rejected. They're nearly clones.

buildup.text: About 10,000 years ago, cheetah populations crashed. The survivors were so few that diversity was decimated.

discovery.text: Bottlenecks shrink genetic diversity randomly. Traits unrelated to fitness are lost simply because few survived.

climax.text: Bottlenecks leave permanent genetic scars. Low diversity means less adaptability when new threats arrive.

punchline.text: Cheetahs survived extinction. Their genes didn't fully recover.

quiz.question: Why are cheetahs so genetically similar?
options: A population bottleneck decimated their diversity
